A full bladder makes your organs appear more clearly. Ultra sound uses sound waves that travel at varying speeds through the tissues and gases around the body. Sound travels better through fluid, (as opposed to tissue and gas) which is why we use a gel contact on the skin, in the first place.

The reason you need a full bladder results from a few different things. The amount of gas you have in the body can impede vision. Gas residing in the intestines blocks a viewable window of anything below the intestines, so filling the bladder to a certain capacity just shoves your intestines out of the way. And, because the bladder is filled with water, it offers a much better way for the sound waves to travel around the deeper areas of the pelvis.
